title: devexp-standup-2026-05-06
body:
Date: 2026-05-06
Time: 10:00am PT
Facilitator: Priya Desai
Attendees: Priya Desai, Alex Kim, Miguel Torres, Sara Nguyen, Ethan Park (+ async updates from Lina and Omar)

Notes / Highlights:
- SDK Release: v0.9.0 RC cut yesterday. Major items in RC: streaming stability fixes, improved error types for rate-limit vs retryable, and a small perf improvement for tokenizers. Alex: smoke tests green on Linux/mac. Windows CI still flaky (see blockers). Plan: cut GA next Tue if no regressions.

- Docs / Quickstarts: Sara finished first pass of the Quickstart rewrite (consolidates JS/TS/py flows into a single page with toggles). PR #88 is up for review; feedback requested by EOD Friday. Also added a short troubleshooting section for connection & auth errors. Miguel will add a short paragraph about Dedicated and Private deployment caveats.

- Samples: New React/Next sample (app-integrations) demoing streaming + function calling landed in draft yesterday. Ethan to wire up live deploy to the preview environment. Need to update README to include runtime config example for Redwood Dedicated.

- CLI / Quickstart tooling: Work on the new quickstart CLI scaffold is blocked by a dependency upgrade in the internal template repo. Lina is coordinating with infra to get the template build fixed. Target unblock: Monday.

- Evals / Examples: We discussed adding a few canned eval prompts to the Quickstart repo so customers can sanity-check their setup. Action: Priya + Miguel to propose 5 starter prompts by next standup.

Blockers:
- Windows CI for SDK: failing intermittently on integration test "streaming-chunk-order" (timeout). Alex to triage with infra; tentative root cause: ephemeral port exhaustion in runner pool. Related ticket: JIRA-4823.
- Template build failing for quickstart CLI (see above). Lina owns follow-up with infra.
- Sample deploy env (preview) occasionally hits rate limits in hosted account during heavy test runs; Ethan to request a rate bump for the preview service account.

Action items (owners):
- Alex: triage Windows CI flakes; post interim mitigation (skip/test marker) by 2026-05-08.
- Sara: incorporate Miguel's Dedicated/Private caveats into Quickstart PR; address reviewer comments by 2026-05-07.
- Miguel: draft the 5 starter eval prompts + add to samples/evals folder; share with Priya by 2026-05-12.
- Ethan: finish React sample README updates; request preview account rate bump; target 2026-05-10.
- Priya: coordinate quickstart CLI unblock meeting with Lina + infra; set agenda and invite by EOD today.

Risks / Notes:
- If Windows CI remains flaky we should gate the GA release on a secondary signal (canary + expanded smoke tests) rather than full Windows passing. Discussed short-term mitigation vs longer-term runner reliability investment.
- Documentation parity: ensure Dedicated/Private examples are not drowned out by hosted-first examples. We agreed to add a top-of-quickstart note with links to Dedicated/Private sections.

Decisions:
- Proceed with v0.9.0 GA next Tue contingent on no regression in mainline smoke tests and a clear mitigation path for Windows CI flakes.
- Add 5 starter eval prompts to the Quickstart repo (optional step for customers) rather than bundling them into core SDK.

Next standup: 2026-05-13 10:00am PT

Quick links (mentioned during the meeting):
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/314
- Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/88
- Blocker ticket: JIRA-4823

Notes to self (informal):
- Remember to ping infra early about preview rate bump requests — they take a few days.
- Consider adding a small CI job that repros the Windows streaming scenario in an isolated runner to avoid noisy pools.
